ATTIKK PRESENTS: AMEN TO THAT LAUNCH PARTY WITH SMILEY MAXX

Fri 24th April 2026, 9pm – 2:30am

Amen To That is about re-igniting the positive energy of the early 90s rave scene when House / Disco / Lost Classics ruled the dance floor.

The venue – Hagglers Corner – is a much-loved independent venue in Sheffield. 586 Queens Road, Sheffield.
